description: The bar chart titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks" compares the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-inst and "Ours (Iterative RLHF)," across various academic and practical benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, which include GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. The bars are grouped by dataset and metric, with each group consisting of two bars side by side, one for each model. The LLaMA-3-8B-inst model is represented by blue bars, while the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model is represented by orange bars. The chart shows that the LLaMA-3-8B-inst model generally outperforms the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model, with the highest score being 80% on GSM-8K and the lowest being 20% on Chat-Arena-Hard. The "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model shows a more consistent performance across the benchmarks, with scores ranging from 30% to 65%. The chart does not indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars, and the values are not annotated on the chart.
